categories.main_business_segments: STEP CO., LTD. operates primarily in the education sector, focusing on the management of cram schools (juku) for elementary, junior high, and high school students, as well as after-school care and nursery services. The company also produces, edits, prints, and binds educational materials. Its main business divisions are the Elementary/Junior High School Division, High School Division, After-school/Nursery Division, and Teaching Material Production/Printing Division.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes high-quality, engaging classroom instruction supported by in-house developed and edited teaching materials. It operates its own Teaching Material Research Department for content creation and an in-house printing and distribution center for material production and logistics. STEP also invests in IT infrastructure for learning environments and uses proprietary systems for student safety and communication with families.
categories.primary_customers_markets: STEP primarily serves students from elementary (grade 5) through high school (grade 12), with a focus on those preparing for high school and university entrance exams. Its customer base includes families seeking academic advancement for their children in Kanagawa Prefecture, as well as parents needing after-school care and nursery services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are concentrated in Kanagawa Prefecture, Japan, with a dense network of schools in cities such as Yokohama, Kawasaki, and Fujisawa. All facilities and services are domestic, with no overseas operations or sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: STEP operates at the downstream end of the education supply chain, directly providing educational services and after-school care to end users (students and families). It also produces its own teaching materials, integrating some midstream functions internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, STEP focuses on maintaining high teaching quality, strengthening its brand as a top performer in public high school entrance results, and expanding its network within Kanagawa. The company prioritizes internal development over rapid expansion, invests in teacher training, and enhances learning environments. While there is no formal R&D department, continuous improvement of teaching methods, materials, and IT systems is emphasized.
categories.revenue_model: STEP generates revenue primarily through tuition and fees for its educational and after-school care services. Teaching material sales are included in the tuition revenue. The company does not rely on subscriptions, licensing, or advertising, and all revenue is derived from direct service provision to students and families.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: STEP faces competition from other cram schools and after-school service providers in the region, including both local and national chains. The company positions itself as a leading brand in Kanagawa, particularly noted for its high success rates in public high school and university entrance exams, and differentiates itself through quality and local dominance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending September 2025, STEP reported revenues of 15.85 billion yen, operating profit of 3.78 billion yen, and net profit of 2.69 billion yen, with steady year-on-year growth (5.0% revenue and 7.2% net profit increase). The company maintains a high equity ratio (89.7%) and has approximately 954 employees. Growth is driven by increased student enrollment and high classroom occupancy, rather than aggressive new school openings.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: STEP’s value proposition centers on high-quality, enjoyable, and effective instruction, supported by proprietary teaching materials and a strong track record of student success in entrance exams. The company emphasizes safety, community trust, and a nurturing environment, aiming to be the top choice for families seeking academic advancement and reliable after-school care in Kanagawa.
